title: feat(app-shell): one page header for every Setup page — sys_* lists, metadata types, settings and component pages (objectui#12606)
body:
Fixes #12606
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

One header component, extended once: the console page header (`ConsolePageHeader`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx`, the objectui#12553 base). No second Setup header was built.

- **Target 1, the header.** Inside the Setup app the header uses a Setup posture: a 32px icon tile, an 18px / 600 title, the kind chip after the title, a 13px muted description on its own line under the title, Refresh as an icon button, and the primary action at the right. The header reads the posture itself from the route's `:appName` (`setup` or `com.objectstack.setup`) through a new `useInSetupApp()` in `console/setupApp.ts`, so no page passes a prop for it. Outside Setup the header keeps the objectui#12423 one row. Three new optional props: `badge` (the kind chip, e.g. `ManagedByBadge`, words unchanged), `breadcrumb` (leading crumbs on the description line) and `refresh` (`onRefresh`, `label`, `busy`). The Setup description line is always drawn, so a page without a description keeps the same title position.
- **Target 2, metadata-type pages under Setup** (Positions, Capabilities, Permission Sets, Datasources). They draw this header with no 'All Metadata Types' breadcrumb and no Items / Filtered tiles. The count is the description ('18 items'). The source and status selects are filter chips. Table headers are sentence case, rows are 36px, and cells are middle-aligned. The per-row Artifact chip is now plain text with its explanation in a tooltip. Outside Setup (the directory, Studio's Open in Setup target) the page keeps today's shape and its `data-testid`s.
- **Target 3, `sys_*` record lists under Setup.** There is no `#` row-number column. ObjectView reads the same route `:appName` and passes one new `ListView` host prop, `defaultRowNumbers`. It is a React prop, not a view key, so no authored metadata changes. Per the maintainer's ruling on the card (option C), the Display control stays on every list, Setup included.
- **Target 4, settings pages.** They keep their form and take the same header. 'All settings' is now the first crumb on the header's description line instead of a button at the top of the form.
- **Component pages.** Packages, Packaged automation, Approvals Inbox, Audit Log Browser and App Marketplace draw their title row through the header, with Refresh as its icon button. Only the header row changed. objectui#12609, objectui#12610, objectui#12607 and objectui#12637 are out of scope and untouched. The icon-only Filter / Sort / Display is objectui#12695, not this PR.

## Deviations

- `SETUP_APP_PACKAGE_ID` and `SETUP_APP_NAME` moved from `console/ConsoleShell.tsx` to `console/setupApp.ts`, so the header can read them without importing the console shell. ConsoleShell re-exports them, so the package root is unchanged.
- `metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx` now exports `WritabilityBadge`. Metadata types have no `managedBy` bucket, so the existing writability badge (create-only / read-only / writable) is their kind chip.
- Two engine-table keys (en and zh) in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `engine.list.itemCount` and `engine.list.itemCountOne`.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` gets the `defaultRowNumbers` host prop, because a plugin package cannot read the route.
- The Packages page header lives in `metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`, not under `views/setup/`.
- Connect an Agent is not converted. It is an authored page whose header is a `page:header` node drawn by `packages/components`, which is outside this card's file surface.
- `SettingsView.pageHeader-12553.test.tsx` is updated because 'All settings' moved from the body into the header.

Sessions reads the same x and y, has the Display trigger, and has 0 row-number cells across 3 rows.

## Test evidence (head 4803770, origin/main 023087f merged)

- Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite as 8 foreground shards (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8`), every shard exit 0. Files: 1458 passed, 1 skipped. Tests: 13740 passed, 9 skipped.
- `packages/plugin-list/`: 141 files, 1464 tests passed. Console settings and system pages: 47 files, 339 tests passed.
- New pins: `PageHeader.setupPosture-12606`, `ResourceListPage.setupPosture-12606`, `ObjectView.setupListChrome-12606` (no `#` column under Setup, Display present) and `ListView.setupChrome-12606`. Each was ablated once and turned red. For example: the Setup posture forced off gave 3 failed; ObjectView passing row numbers on gave 2 failed; the Display panel suppressed gave 5 failed. Each was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `type-check` (app-shell, plugin-list, console), `build` (console and its dependencies), eslint on the changed files (0 errors), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` and the changeset-presence check: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Below `sm`, the one-row posture hides the description line. Outside Setup, a phone therefore does not show the 'All settings' crumb. The Setup posture keeps it.
